page.layout: One page of running text, no margin notes. Numbered items 8 to 16 run down the page in one column, with the running head "PRÆFATIO." and page number 94 at the top.

main_text.p: 9. Psalmi Æthiopici,Canticum Canticorum, & N.Test. Æthiopicum cum versione Latina.
11. Liber Esther Canonicus, cum Tobit, Ju-dith, Maccab. uno, qui nec Syriace nec Arabice in Parisiensi habentur, ut ex MSS. quibusdam typis mandentur, operam dabi-mus.

12. Prolegomena seu Apparatus,in quibus quæ-stiones quæ de Textu Hebr.& Græco, de versio-num singularum antiquitate,authoritate & usu, & de variis lectionibus inter doctos agitantur ; cum Chronologia sacra ab orbe condito, Tabulis Geographicis terræ Sanctæ,&c. descriptione Tem-pli, Tabernaculi, eorumque utensilium, vestitus Aaronici,&c.

13. Varia lectiones Textûs Hebr. ubi de Keri, Ketib,&c. de variis lectionibus exemplarium Ben Ascher & Ben Nephthali, de literis defici-entibus,redundantibus,&c. aliisque quæ ad tex-tum illustrandum & confirmandum conferunt; Buxtorfii Clavis Masoreth.& Castigationes Masoræ,&c.
14. Differentia Textûs Hebr. à Textu Samari-tano, cum variis lectionibus ex codicum Sama-ritanorum collatione, notis & observationibus, viri doctissimi operâ collectis.
15. Flaminii Nobilii in Rom. 70. nota & lectio-nes varia longè doctissima, cum fragmentis veterum Translationum, Aquila, Sym. & Theo-dot. 5. & 6. Anonym. per Drufium & alios col-lectis.

page.notes: Long s (s) rendered as plain s throughout. Italic type on the title lines and the Hebrew and Latin book titles is a best reading of the scan. Item number "10." may be printed as "1o." ; read as 10. The "s" in "Parisiensi" and similar forms are set as printed. The superscript 6 in "& 6." is set on the line. The printed "Textûs" keeps its circumflex. Last line "16. Patricii" is the start of a paragraph that goes on on the next page.
